events.title: Morning Steward began its watch
events.summary: A private, read-only observation now runs every morning at 09:00 local time and refreshes this brief.
details: It compares each day with the previous observation.
It never deletes, moves, uploads, or installs anything.
It raises attention only for meaningful storage loss, concentration of growth, or incomplete coverage.

events.title: The machine got breathing room
events.summary: Generated developer data and application caches were removed after review. Personal files, source code, current device support, and agent history were preserved.
details: Free space increased from 8.8 GB to 59 GB.
Desktop project storage fell from 35 GB to 14 GB.
Unity libraries, Android builds, Gradle/npm caches, Xcode Derived Data, and older Xcode support were cleared.
